text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yawn… I slept like a baby today… Ahhh…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh? That's weird—I feel like I was reeled in over here or something…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hello? Three Goddesses? Were you the ones who called me here?
